name: Mention Input
description: @people and #channels become single tokens inside a note. The suggestion list follows the caret, and backspace takes a token whole.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading, also the textbox’s accessible name.

props.name: value
props.default: a note that already mentions @mara and #legal
props.description: The note. @handle and #channel that match people and channels paint as tokens. Read once, when the field mounts.

props.name: people
props.description: People an @ can turn into a token. The label is the first name; the stored value keeps the handle.

props.name: channels
props.description: Channels a # can turn into a token. The name is both the label and the stored value.

props.name: placeholder
props.default: "Write a note. @ mentions a person, # a channel."
props.description: Shown in the empty well. It is not part of the value.

props.name: showHint
props.description: The mono line under the well. It changes while a suggestion list is open.

props.name: voice
props.description: Sans for a working note, serif when the sentence should read like the document. Channel tokens stay mono.

props.name: onChange
props.description: The note as plain text, with tokens written back to @handle and #name.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: person tokens, their active avatar ring, and the text selection. Channel tokens stay neutral.
